discussion.body: Halric Bent. Main-side. Added so main-side count is eight. Iron's Gate / Breskshire heavy knight. Cael's foil: the squire who stayed. Joins Act 1. Design: full Gate harness, FF8 military tailoring. Death crises: covers Cael in the heat-death scene; Act 5 camp gate. Default lives. Contingency: unnamed captain takes command; Breskshire still has an army. No romance track. If dead, Cael carries the Gate failure personally; Liraen notices; that is character texture, not a new ending.
